desc:
Welcome to RO THEFT AUTO 6!

Explore a huge open-world city, drive through busy streets, discover new areas, and build your own story with friends.

🚗 Drive cars around the city
🏙️ Explore different locations
💰 Complete jobs and activities
👥 Play and roleplay with friends

More vehicles, missions, locations, and features are planned for future updates!

⚠ THIS GAME IS STILL IN EARLY ACCESS— YOU MAY ENCOUNTER UNFINISHED FEATURES, BUGS & GLITCHES ⚠
